# projected standpoint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:projectedStandpoint`](gmeow-projectedStandpoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/projectedStandpoint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

The standpoint claim that the deceiver projects to the deceived party — the public or communicated position that diverges from the held standpoint in a deception event. Non-functional: a complex deception may project several standpoints to different audiences.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)
